text.heading: Why This Needs Template Intelligence
text.body:
Raw PDF content rarely fits directly into a slide. The system first understands the document, then writes content according to each template's layout and character limits.

This prevents overloaded slides and keeps the deck consistent.

text.heading: Upload and Track Progress
text.body: The UI should let users upload a PDF, set slide count, track status, and download the final PPTX when generation is complete.

text.heading: System Targets
text.subheading: Core numbers for the first working version.

text.heading: Design Protection Rules
text.body_left: The builder only replaces approved text and image placeholders.
text.body_right: Fonts, colors, logos, icons, layouts, and brand assets remain untouched.

text.heading: Generated Visuals When Needed
text.body: Images are generated only when the selected template has an intended image area or the slide requires a visual.
